g.text: Multi-Tenant Business Management Cloud • NestJS v12 • PostgreSQL (Supabase) • Prisma v6 • BullMQ
EDGE GATEWAY, SECURITY MIDDLEWARE & GUARDS PIPELINE
NESTJS APPLICATION CORE — BUSINESS DOMAIN SUBSYSTEMS
Controllers • DTOs • Domain Services • Prisma Transactions
Per-recipient delivery pipeline: QUEUED ➔ SENT ➔ DELIVERED ➔ READ
Dispatches jobs asynchronously to BullMQ queue workers
Order state machine: PENDING ➔ CONFIRMED ➔ DELIVERED ➔ CANCELLED
Automated WhatsApp Order Confirmation & Notification triggers
Transactional notifications & campaign blasts via Resend
Rate-controlled WhatsApp Business Cloud API dispatches
Telephony SMS broadcasts & OTP delivery verification
Async webhook retries, dead-letter queue (DLQ) & audits
PrismaService singleton with connection pooling & auto-migrations
OAuth • REST APIs • Webhooks • Distributed Telemetry
